candidates.title: BEHOLD! the angel clown show

Messy, salacious, and confused, this ancient and childlike being has a message for humanity... but how can it get anything done while every atom and sense of its new body screams with delightful, delicious, and terrible urgency?!
Let this supernatural being take you for an hour of surreal sacramental exchanges, including apocalyptic fanfares and ecstasies, a serenade to feet, and an ode to holes.
Each showing will be presented as a double feature with "Three Holes To Hollywood" by Mitchell Ryan.
